mapper.sql: like_id, target_type, target_id, user_id, user_type, source_url, delete_yn, created_by, created_ip, created_at, updated_by, updated_ip, updated_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_bbs_like ( like_id, target_type, target_id, user_id, user_type, source_url, delete_yn, created_by, created_ip, created_at, updated_by, updated_ip, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{likeId}, #{targetType}, #{targetId}, #{userId}, #{userType}, #{sourceUrl}, 'N', #{createdBy}, #{createdIp}, COALESCE(#{createdAt}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP), #{updatedBy}, #{updatedIp}, COALESCE(#{updatedAt}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) )
mapper.update: UPDATE tb_bbs_like SET delete_yn = 'Y', updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE like_id = #{likeId}
UPDATE tb_bbs_like SET delete_yn = 'N', updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE like_id = #{likeId}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM tb_bbs_like WHERE delete_yn = 'Y' AND updated_at <= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 1 MONTH)
